Jason Obawemimo owns and operates Triple J Auto Investment, a Houston dealership, and builds the CRM, voice AI and automation systems that run it. Since June 2025 he has personally closed 53 vehicle sales and collected $206,777 in sale proceeds. He is also the founder of Obavia, a dealership sale desk in development for Texas independent dealers. He lives in Pearland, Texas. Title: AI Implementation, Workflow Automation and CRM Systems.

Triple J Auto Investment: Houston used vehicle dealership at 8774 Almeda Genoa Rd, owned and operated by Jason (Owner and Operations Lead of Triple J Auto Investment and Rental Operations since August 2024), open Monday to Saturday 9 to 7, with in-house financing, sell and trade valuations, and registration and title support. Jason manages its operations across pricing, inventory, vendors, logistics, financing and title processing.

Systems Jason built at Triple J: a custom dealership CRM and its Handle a Sale desk, which are one system (TypeScript, React, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Vercel, Edge Functions; lead-to-title data model, roles, validation and tested row-level security; used daily by three staff across inventory, deals and follow-up); inbound voice AI (Retell AI, Bland AI, Twilio, CRM webhooks) that books appointments into the CRM and live-transfers unresolved calls to staff; and a prospecting workflow (Python, Claude API, n8n, CRM webhooks) that researches Facebook Marketplace leads, writes findings to the CRM, and generates SOP-based reply text for automatic follow-up. Across August and September 2026 the voice AI averaged 41 inbound calls, 14 booked appointments and 4 CRM-matched vehicle sales per month ($15,000 a month in sale proceeds); keep the word "CRM-matched", do not say the voice AI caused the sales, and do not compute rates or percentages from these numbers. The prospecting workflow is Triple J's live lead-research workflow, not Obavia's Reach.

Obavia: a dealership sale desk in development for Texas independent dealers. "Every sale, start to signed." It grew out of Handle a Sale at Triple J. It is not yet live; it claims no customers, results or conversion rates, and Text it to sign, Reach (posting cars to Facebook Marketplace from the salesperson's own phone) and dealer websites are in development, not live. People and figures in its demos and ads are fictional.

Earlier project: Obavia was previously called Apohenia (2024, apohenia.com), a Texas deal-paperwork project that built Deal Packet Checker. It is not affiliated with TxDMV, webDEALER, or any county office.

Education and honor: Bachelor of Science in Neuroscience, The University of Texas at Austin, expected 2028. Associate of Arts in Business from San Jacinto College, Houston, graduated May 2026, GPA 3.63, Dean's Honor List. Google AI Essentials, Google (Coursera), 2026. Nineteen completed Anthropic courses.
